in_sanskrit.name: Ansman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Answer, Resolver, Solver
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ansman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ansman is a name of divine origin in Hinduism, meaning the one who provides answers, resolves problems and solves difficulties. It is a powerful name associated with wisdom, courage, and leadership.
